_note: v3.0 43 H2: M43-P1 stuck-ladder SKELETON, NOT RUN; schema-validated only. Arm = install setting pacing.stuckLadder (on/off), set before the run; the first step records which arm ran. Each turn records the active checkpoint and which lead the guidance block (story_orchestrator_guidance) shows. The ten player lines are FIXED and never act on a lead, so turns-to-exit cannot move between arms: the row's floor (median turns to exit -30%) needs a reacting player that reads the reply and follows a shown lead. That player is owed (gpu-queue M43-P1 note), not built here.
